preconditions.description: Input constraints: n is the number of nodes, m is the number of edges, and k is the minimum degree of each node.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid range.
The number of edges provided matches the input m.

preconditions.expression: all(len(adj_list) >= k for adj_list in adjacency_lists)
preconditions.description: Each node has at least k neighbors (degree >= k). adjacency_lists is the adjacency list representation of the graph.

postconditions.description: The cycle length r is at least k + 1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for v in cycle)
postconditions.description: All nodes in the cycle are within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(cycle[i] != cycle[j] for i in range(len(cycle)) for j in range(i + 1, len(cycle)))
postconditions.description: All nodes in the cycle are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all((cycle[i], cycle[i + 1]) in edges or (cycle[i + 1], cycle[i]) in edges for i in range(len(cycle) - 1)) and ((cycle[-1], cycle[0]) in edges or (cycle[0], cycle[-1]) in edges)
postconditions.description: The cycle is simple: consecutive nodes and the first/last nodes are connected by edges.
